item_short_desc: Rothco’s Lensatic Metal Compass is the ultimate navigation tool for outdoor enthusiasts, hikers, and explorers. Encased in a durable metal housing, this compass is built to withstand tough conditions and provide reliable performance. The floating luminous dial and adjustable luminous marching line ensure easy navigation, even in low-light environments, while the magnifying viewer allows for precise, detailed readings. With its built-in sighting hairline and thumb hold for added stability, aiming and reading directions becomes a breeze.
